properties.name_en: Phase 0: field verification and interface confirmation
properties.scope_note: The shared polygon is a provisional concept-work range, not a construction boundary, ownership boundary or statutory phasing line.
properties.resource_boundary: conceptual verification and governance resource only; no budget, procurement, land right or approval is claimed
properties.entry_gate: Lawful field-verification permission and a named professional verification role are available.
properties.exit_gate: Baseline ledger records route location, public-entry condition, legal crossing, accessible-route condition, maintenance responsibility and required midday measurements.
properties.hold_condition: Any missing or unrecordable critical access, safety, ownership/interface or maintenance condition holds the phase.
properties.failure_response: Do not advance to physical pilot; retain unknown evidence status and remove unsupported route claims.
properties.completion_criteria: A human verifier records each selected route's public access, entry, crossing, accessible detour, maintenance responsibility and midday evidence gap before any pilot is described as usable.

properties.scope_note: The shared polygon is a provisional concept-work range, not a construction boundary, ownership boundary or statutory phasing line.
properties.resource_boundary: conceptual reversible-pilot resource only; no budget, procurement, land right or approval is claimed
properties.entry_gate: Phase 0 confirms the relevant public interface, clearway and responsible pilot/maintenance role for each selected segment.
properties.exit_gate: Reversible signs, stay-space prototype and staffed fallback have passed a documented AI-OFF and clearway exercise without claiming verified SLA-A.
properties.hold_condition: Closed entry, inaccessible route, test occupation of clearway, absent staffing or unmaintainable water/signage holds the affected pilot.
properties.failure_response: Reroute, stop the test/display, downgrade the service claim or remove the affected pilot component.
properties.completion_criteria: The selected pilot keeps a clearway, a reversible physical information layer and an accountable human fallback through a documented AI-OFF exercise.

properties.name_zh: Phase 2：三区连接与经确认设施深化
properties.name_en: Phase 2: three-area connections and confirmed-facility deepening
properties.scope_note: The shared polygon is a provisional concept-work range, not a construction boundary, ownership boundary or statutory phasing line.
properties.resource_boundary: conceptual professional-deepening resource only; no budget, procurement, land right or approval is claimed
properties.entry_gate: Selected entries, crossings, accessible detours, maintenance responsibility, operating permission and relevant professional constraints are confirmed for the affected intervention.
properties.exit_gate: Connection and fixed-facility proposals have a recalculated evidence record, approved responsible role and documented fallback procedure.
properties.hold_condition: Any unconfirmed legal crossing, unacceptable accessible detour, unapproved interface, utility/safety constraint or missing operator responsibility holds the affected work package.
properties.failure_response: Return to Phase 1 reversible mode, reroute via a verified alternative, or suspend the intervention; no automatic SLA promotion.
properties.completion_criteria: Professional teams may deepen only the interfaces whose access, crossing, accessible alternative, operations and maintenance record are confirmed.

properties.name_zh: Phase 3：经证据验证后的有限扩大
properties.name_en: Phase 3: bounded expansion after evidence verification
properties.scope_note: The shared polygon is a provisional concept-work range, not a construction boundary, ownership boundary or statutory phasing line.
properties.resource_boundary: conceptual sustained-stewardship resource only; no budget, procurement, land right or approval is claimed
properties.entry_gate: Human field verification completes the applicable ledger evidence, the Engine is rechecked, and operating responsibility is sustainable for the proposed expansion.
properties.exit_gate: An expanded service segment retains documented physical fallback, maintenance and failure-response records through an agreed review period.
properties.hold_condition: Any rejected mandatory evidence, loss of public access, unsafe crossing, inaccessible alternative, failed maintenance or absent staffing holds expansion.
properties.failure_response: Keep Verified SLA at B or lower, contract to a verified segment, or remove the expansion claim; phase progression never auto-promotes SLA.
properties.completion_criteria: Expansion retains auditable physical fallback, maintenance and failure-response evidence through an agreed review period; it never follows from an AI score alone.
